items.title: Federal prosecutors allege the scheme also tried to recruit two other NBA players after the alleged game involving Rozier, including one of his then teammates on the Hornets.
items.author: Mike Vorkunov
items.body_excerpt:
Federal prosecutors allege the scheme also tried to recruit two other NBA players after the alleged game involving Rozier, including one of his then teammates on the Hornets. 

Deniro Laster, Rozier's friend allegedly texted another NBA player: "(Let me know) if u tryna make 100k gang"

quote.author: Mike Vorkunov
quote.text: The NBA's internal investigation into Terry Rozier could soon become a key part of the federal sports gambling trial for the NBA vet. DOJ prosecutors allege Rozier lied during the investigation and asked a judge to allow that alleged evidence at trial. www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...

media.title: NBA’s Terry Rozier investigation could become part of illegal gambling trial (Gift Article)
media.description: Federal prosecutors claim that Rozier lied to NBA investigators and deleted text messages with alleged conspirators in a recent filing.

items.title: Also at issue is a text sent by Rozier's friend and the only other defendant remaining in the case. Rozier's lawyers say it proves Rozier didn't know about the betting scheme and is innocent. Prosecutors say it doesn't and it was not about the betting scheme.

quote.text:
The NBA has reached deals with Kalshi and Polymarket to make them the league's preferred prediction markets partners. The companies can now use NBA IP on their platforms, while the NBA gets right of approval on markets that they offer. That and more:
